tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs grub gnyis mchog stsol zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru ār+ya tā ra ye// srid zhi'i 'ching sgrol bcom ldan mas// 'di nas snying po'i bar du ni// spyi bo'i rgyan du zhabs pad+mo// 'bral med rjes su 'dzin par mdzod// ces mchod par brjod pa sngon du song nas de la 'dir rgyal ba'i yum 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgo nas mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub myur du 'dod pa'i rnal 'byor pa dag gis bsnyen cing sgrub pa la mchod pa'i rim par bdag bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bum sgrub/ rjes su gnang ba dang bcas gsal bar dgod par bya ste/ de yang phun sum tshogs pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas dben par gtsang sbra dang ldan pas/ ra ba bzhi yi dkar po'i phyogs sam/ yang na dkar po'i phyogs gang 'dod kyi 'grub sbyor bzang por mchod pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bar bgyid la/ mchod pa'i rten spyi dang bye brag 'phags ma'i sku brnyan thang ka sogs gang 'byor bshams pa'i mdun du/ stegs kyi khar maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bru dkar gyi tshom bur bkod pa'i khar mañji'i steng bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa chu gtsang gis sum gnyis bkang ba bum rdzas dri bzang yang btab la/ de steng dung chos gzungs rdor kha rgyan dang bcas pa bshams/ mdun ngos su nyer spyod kyi mchod pa rnams phreng tshar dang*/ rin po che'i snod du gtor zlum dkar mngar gyis sbags pa dang*/ bsang chu sngon gtor sogs 'du bar byas la/ nangs snga bar khrus dang spos kyi byugs pas lus gtsang mar bsgos la stan bde bar 'khod de/ sems can thams cad la snying rje dang byang sems kyis kun nas bslangs te/ dang po bsang chu'i don du oṃ badz+ra kro dha nyer gcig brjod la khro bo'i rang bzhin nus ldan du mos te gnas dang yo byad rnams la bsang gtor bya/ gnyis pa bgegs dang bar chad bsal ba'i don du/ phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag rnams la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/

swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūm̐ las rin chen snod yangs par// kham̐ zhu gtor ma bdud rtsi dngos// 'dod yon dwangs shing thogs pa med// longs spyod mtha' yas char 'bebs gyur// oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ lan gsum/ a kā ro sa sbyangs spel byin gyis brlabs/ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis lan gsum 'bul/ phyogs skyong 'jig rten skyong ba dang*// sa bdag gnas bdag yul gyi lha// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// gang 'dir lta bar mi dbang ba'i// nyer 'tshe glags ltar gyur pa yi// gdon bgegs log 'dren phyir dengs shig /ye shes bskal mes sreg par byed// badz+ra kro dha sum+bha ni sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod bgegs bskrad/ gsum pa srung ba'i 'khor lo ni/ phyogs mtshams 'od dang 'od zer 'phro// ye shes me ri sna lnga 'bar// rdo rje ut+pal la sogs kyi// srung ba'i 'khor los bar med gtams// oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ yig las// rin chen snod du hūm̐ yig tshogs// 'od zhu mchod rdzas dpag tu med// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// rab 'byams rgya chen ji snyed pa// chos dbyings rgyas par gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da bar brjod/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a brta ya bh+ya swā hā/ lan gsum brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ lnga pa skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog /bla ma yi dam chos skyong ste// mchog gsum rtsa gsum bdag nyid can// 'phags ma sgrol ma'i zhabs pad+mor// bdag sogs sems can deng bzung nas// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// bdun nam nyer gcig brjod/

sems bskyed pa ni/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// bde ba mchog la drangs pa'i phyir// bla med theg chen sems bskyed nas// sgo gsum dge la 'jug par bya// lan gsum brjod la/ oṃ bodhi tsit+ta ut+pā da yā mi/ drug pa tshogs zhing ni/ rang nyid skad cig rje btsun ma// rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs// gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ges mtshan// de las 'od 'phros ye shes sems// dkon mchog rgya mtsho ma lus pa// mdun gyi nam mkhar gsal bar gyur// oṃ ār+ya tā re badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ na ma ār+ya tā ra ya/ mchod pa 'bul lo bshags so yi rang ngo*// bskul zhing gsol ba 'debs so dge tshogs rgyun// thar pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur bsngo'o// zhes bsdus pa'i tshul gyis yan lag bdun pa phul nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes rang la bstim/ bdun pa tshad med bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde dang bde rgyur ldan// sdig dang sdug bsngal rgyu dang bral bar shog /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde dang mi 'bral zhing*// btang snyoms chen po'i ngang du gnas gyur cig / lan gsum/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa la dang po rang lhar gsal btab pa ni/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ chos rnams thams cad stong nyid gyur// stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las ni// pad+ma dkar po dri ma med// 'dab ma ge sar mchog tu yangs// steng du a las zla shel gyi// dkyil 'khor nya gang dbus su tām̐// dkar po 'od dang 'od zer 'bar// 'phros pas rgyal mchod dngos grub bsdus// sems can 'jigs pa kun las bsgral// tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las// rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar// shin tu dwangs shing gsal 'tsher ba// zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan dkyus ring*// yid 'ong sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan// g.yas pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya dang*// g.yon pas mtheb srin ut+pa la// dkar po yal 'dab rgyas pa bsnams// dbu skra mthon mthing thor tshugs bcings// yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// gser dang mu tig la sogs pas// cod pan snyan dang mgul gyi rgyan// phyag zhabs gdu bu dpung rgyan dang*// se mo do dang ska rags 'phyang*// brgyad gnyis lang tsho'i cha shas rdzogs// nu 'bur zung mdzes lha yi gos// dkar pos stod g.yogs dbang gzhu yi// smad g.yogs zhabs gnyis skyil mo krung*// zla ba'i rgyab yol gsal bar gyur// gnas gsum oṃ dkar āḥdamar po// thugs ka'i cha smad hūm̐ sngon gsal// thugs ka'i dbus su pad zlar tāṃ// dkar po'i 'od kyis ye shes pa// rang bzhin gnas dang khyad par du// lho phyogs gru 'dzin po ṭa la'i// gnas kyi zhing mchog dam pa nas// bskyed pa dang 'dra'i ye shes pa// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sras dang slob ma sprul pa'i tshogs// ji snyed du mas bskor ba rnams// mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig la// spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

zhes spyan drangs la/ gnyis pa mchod cing bstod pa ni/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis// sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥye shes sems// dam tshig pa dang dbyer med gyur// gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs las 'od 'phros te// dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs nas// mchod pa'i sprin gyis mnyes par byas// gsol btab mod la ye shes kyi// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyi dbang bskur thob// sku gang dri ma dag par byas// chu zhabs yar brten 'od dpag med// sprul sku'i rnam pas rgyas gdab gyur// de nas bzhi pa sngags 'khor bsgom pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i thugs ka'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ mu khyud lnga dang ldan pa'i lte bar tām̐/ g.yas su oṃ dang g.yon du hā/ mdun nas g.yas bskor du ma ma ā yu puṇ+ya dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru hā/ rtsibs brgyad la tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā/ zhes pas mtshan pa dang*/ mu khyud nang ma la/ a li g.yon bskor/ bar ma la ka li g.yas bskor/ phyi rim la ye dharma g.yas su bskor zhing*/ de yi phyi rim rdo rje dkar po mchur nyal ba'i phreng ba dang*/ de yi yang phyi rol du 'od dkar po'i zer thag gi phreng ba dang ldan pa'i sngags 'khor las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi thugs rje byin rlabs dngos grub dang*/ brtan g.yo snod kyi 'byung ba'i rtsi dang*/ bcud kyis bsdus pa'i lha klu rig 'dzin grub pa la sogs pa 'gro ba mtha' dag gi dpal 'byor thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim pas 'chi ba med pa'i tshe dang rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas par gyur/ zhes sngags 'khor bsgoms la/ yi ge bcu pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ tshe sham can yang bzla'o// de nas mdun bskyed sgrub cing mchod pa ni/ dang po bdag bskyed ltar la khyad par/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar//

zhes pa sogs dang spyan 'dren nas rgyas gdab par bya'o// de nas gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ dri med mchod yon dag byed zhabs bsil dang*// yid 'ong me tog mkha' khyab bdug pa'i spos// snang byed mar me rmad byung dri yi mchog /bcud ldan zhal zas dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra// 'khor ba ji srid mchod pa'i sprin spros nas// rgyal yum 'phags ma'i lha tshogs rnams la 'bul// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhūp+pe/ ā lo ke/ ghan+dhe/ nai wi d+ya/ shab+da 'i bar brjod la rol mo 'bul lo// 'dod yon 'bul ba ni/ 'jig rten 'di na rdo rje'i gzugs sgra dri// bshos gtsang srab 'jam lha yi dar sna tshogs// rab 'byams zhing rnams ma lus yongs bkang nas// bcom ldan yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha la 'bul// sngags kyi thog mtha' sngar bzhin/ rū pa/ shab+da/ gan+dhe/ ra sa/ spar+she sogs kyang brjod/ dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa yi// ri rab gling bzhi gling phran brgyad// nyi zla la sogs mchod pa'i rdzas// sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul// oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza āḥhūm̐/ rje btsun bcom ldan 'das ma thugs rje can// zhes pa nas/ yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod// ces pa'i bar gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas gsum pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ las sngags kyis bsangs/ swabhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis lan bdun nam gsum gyis phul/ bstod pa ni/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang*/ bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas rnams kyis// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs brjod la/ bzhi pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed lha yi thugs ka'i sngags phreng las// 'od 'phros phyi snod nang bcud kun la phog

/tshe dpal 'byor pa 'od dang 'od zer gyi// rnam par bsdus nas sngags phreng la thim gyur// zhes mos la bzlas pa bya'o// de nas bum bskyed ni/ dang po las sngags kyis bsangs sbyangs/ chos kun stong pa chen po'i ngang*// pam̐ las pad+ma a las ni// zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ yig las// rin chen bum pa mtshan nyid rdzogs// bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ba'i dbus// bdag bskyed ltar la/ pad+ma dkar po dri ma med// ces sogs dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar/ zhes pa'i khyad par las gzhan dkyus ltar spyan 'dren dang rgyas gdab bar bton/ gnyis pa mchod bstod ni/ o ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa dang*/ rū pa/ shab+da sogs kyang brjod/ rgyal mchog tshe dpag med pa'i yum// 'chi med nges par ster ba mo// rig pa 'dzin ma bcom ldan 'das// rje btsun sgrol mar phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ gsum pa bzlas pa ni/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas sngags phreng thon/ bum lha'i thugs kar zhugs pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas srid zhi ma lus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te bum lhar thim par gyur ces par mos la yi ge bcu pa bzla'o// mthar/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dung chos kyi chu mchod yon du phul nas/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ bcom ldan 'das ma bum pa'i chu dang dbyer med par 'od du zhu bar gyur/ ces bum lha 'od zhu dang*/ skabs 'dir gzhan gyi don rjes gnang sbyin pa sogs spro na/ dang po rang nyid kyis ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs nas/ gnyis pa slob ma rnams la dung chos chab kyis khrus dang*/ sngar bshad pa ltar sngon 'gro bgegs bskrad srung 'khor bar bya/ de nas gsum pa dbang gi thog mar spyi bshad cung zad spro na/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya snyam pa'i thugs bskyed dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gsan 'tshal/

de la yang mthar thug phyir mi ldog pa mchog gi go 'phang dang*/ gnas skabs su bgegs dang bar chad nyon mongs pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal ba'i don du 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba yin te/ de yang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyud las/ 'chi ba bslu byed dkar mo'o// zhes pas bstan cing*/ 'di yi sgrub thabs kyi rgya gzhung slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug ces bya ba mkhas pa dang grub pa'i khyu mchog de nyid dngos su rje btsun ma yis byin gyis brlabs shing rjes su bzung bar brten 'di yi rig pa'i skor rgyud sde so so nas gsungs pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i bstan bcos 'chi bslu kun btus su grags pa bkral bar mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang man ngag gi rnam pa du ma 'phags mas dngos su gdams/ des bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po la gnang zhing sgrub pas zhal gzigs thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i tshul du ma bstan par mdzad pa rnams bstan bcos su yi ger btab/ de la brten nas sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba yang 'ga' zhig tu spel/ de la ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags kyis gsan cing rjes su 'dzin/ rgyud dang sgrub thabs kyi skor rnams ma 'dres so sor rtogs pa'i rgya gzhung rnams bod du spyan drangs nas bsgyur cing gtan la phab nas gsal bar byed pa'i gnas su ston par mdzad/ de la dge ba'i bshes gnyen gle nag pas gsan/ de la sgre pa/ des rgyal bas lung gis zin pa'i bstan pa'i bdag po mnyam med dwags po rin po che zla 'od gzhon nu la gnang zhing de nas rim pas kaṃ tshang sgrub brgyud 'di nyid kyi snying po don gyi brgyud pa dang gcig 'dres su gyur cing*/ yang rje btsun mas bla ma gser gling pa/ des jo bo rje/ dge bshes ston pa/ spyan snga ba/ sgre pa nas dwags po rin po cher 'dus pa dang*/ yang lugs gcig la sgrol mas jo bo rje dī paṃ ka ra/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa/

snyug rum pa nas dwags po rin po cher 'dus pa ste/ bka' babs chu bo gsum 'brel rje sgam po par 'dus pa dang*/ gzhan yang kha che paṇa chen nas brgyud pa dang*/ grub chen rin po che karma pak+shi nas brgyud pa/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po nas brgyud pa sogs mdor na bka' babs kyi chu bo drug gcig tu 'dus pa yang snang zhing*/ de ltar byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa/ gong ma dag gi rdo rje'i gsung las/ 'chi ltas ci ltar byung yang nges par bzlog nus pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rig sngags dang sgrub pa rtsis su mdzad cing thugs nyams su bstar ba yang ches mang bar byung zhing*/ de dag kyang phrin las rgya che zhing 'gro don rgyas pa sogs lhag pa'i lha 'di nyid la bsten nas grub pa brnyes pa kho na ste/ de lta bu'ang brgyud pa rin po che 'di dag las byung zhing tshul bzhin du sgrub par byas na 'chi med kyi tshe dang rgud med kyi lang tsho/ gzhan yang dngos grub ci 'dod pa mtha' dag yid bzhin du nges par 'byung zhing*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba sogs 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug las skyob nus pa dang*/ mthar thug chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i ngang du dbyer med par sangs rgyas pa sogs 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ de yang paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i kun btus las/ tshangs dbang khyab 'jug nyi zla dang*// drag po phyogs skyong 'dod lhas kyang*// ba spu'i khung bu'ang gcod mi nus// 'chi bdag las rgyal sgrol ma bzhin// skra dkar gnyer ma skal ngan nad// dbul ba la sogs nyams par byed// seng ge la sogs 'jigs chen brgyad// sdug bsngal tshogs rnams sel bar byed// slong ba med par bza' btung gos// khang bzang rin chen sna tshogs 'du// ral gri mig sman rkang mgyogs dang*// bum pa bzang po la sogs 'grub// snyan ngag dang ni rtsod pa mkhas// blo rno shes rab dri ma med// gzhan yang ci 'dod dngos grub ni// 'khor lo 'di las 'byung bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar phan pa'i yon tan mtha' yas shing brjod kyis mi lang mod kyang*/

cung zad spros pa de dag nges par gyis la sgo gsum gyi dad dang dang ba chen pos yid spro ba'i ngang nas dbang bskur zab mo smin grol gyi lam la 'jug pa'i phyir du dngos dang yid sprul rgya mtshos drangs ba'i maṇ+ḍal gnang bar zhu/

zhes maṇ+ḍal phul la/ slob dpon gyis/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul ba sngon du song nas thog mar bdag slob dpon du 'os pa dang rje btsun ma dbyer med pa la dbang bskur zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rgyal ba rab 'byams 'dus pa'i dpal// bla ma dang ni rje btsun mar// gsol 'debs smin grol lam zab mo// ma lus bka' drin stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ mdun gyi nam mkhar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs la// sangs rgyas byang sems rdul snyed sprin phung gtibs pa bzhin// bskor ba'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa 'bul ba'i blos// rtse gcig gus pas thal sbyar 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/ de nas bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa'i don du ni// gsal stong 'dzin med ngang du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod// oṃ badz+ra kro dha sa slob ma rnams bsangs la/ oṃ shū n+ya ta sogs bdag bskyed ji bzhin pa la/ khyed rang 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar// zhes sogs nas/ thugs ka'i dbus su pad zlar tām̐// 'od zer dkar po 'bar ba can// snang stong 'dzin med 'ja' tshon ltar// bkra zhing lam mer gsal bar bsgom// ces dmigs pa spor la/ de nas rgyud la ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs myur du 'bebs pa'i phyir/ bla ma sgrol ma tha mi dad par gsol gdab 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po ches/ bdag dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol ba'i phyir/ rje btsun yid bzhin 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i ye shes dam pas smin par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum gsol ba btab/ de ltar gsol btab slob dpon thugs ka nas// 'od 'phros mdun bskyed lha yi thugs rgyud bskul// thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang tām̐ las 'od zer 'phros// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams thams cad snang bar byas// rang bzhin gnas dang khyad par lho phyogs kyi// po ṭa la yi gnas mchog dam pa nas// bsgom pa dang 'dra'i bcom ldan sgrol ma dkar// sangs rgyas byang sems rgya mtsho ma lus pa// sprin phung gtibs pa lta bu'i ye shes sems// mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig spyan drangs nas// khyed rnams lhar gsal sku la gnyis med par// thugs rje'i byin rlabs dngos grub char ltar babs// 'chi med don dam ye shes rgyud la zhugs// sems nyid bde ba chen po 'od gsal ba// g.yo 'gul med pa'i ngang du gnas par mdzod// oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra ma hā badz+ra dz+nyā na a we sha ya/

a we sha ya a a a/ zhes spos 'thul/ rol mo bkrol la ye shes pa gzhug nas/ de ltar babs pa'i lha de nyid// snying po'i bar du mi 'bral bar// skal ldan rgyud la brtan gyur cig /dz+nyā na badz+ra tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje mgor bzhag /dang po sku yi rjes gnang ni/ slar yang slob dpon snying ga'i 'od zer gyis// bskul bas dbang lha rigs lnga yab yum rnams// spyan drangs mchod pa'i sprin gyi rgya mtshos mchod// oṃ pañca ku la badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da 'i bar brjod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lha rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis gang ba bsnams nas dbang bskur ba'i mos pa gyis shig /ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs brjod/ de ltar dbang bskur sgrib pa bzhi dag cing*// sku bzhi mngon byas 'chi med tshe dpal thob// chu zhabs gyen brten 'od dpag dbu brgyan gyur// de ltar sku mchog bum pa'i dbang thob nas// lha yi rnal 'byor bskyed rim bsgom par dbang// 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang ni/ slob dpon lhar gsal zhal nas sngags phreng thon// slob ma'i zhal zhugs thugs kar thim pa'i mod// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi gsung gsang ba// mi bzad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i snying po rnams// dngos grub tshur byon khyed rang snying khar thim// 'khor bar mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// sngags phreng gtad la yi ge bcu pa bzla'o/ /slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di yi rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis sogs lan gsum/ me tog de nyid spyi bor 'ching bar mos shig /bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// sogs brjod me tog spyi bor bkod/ de ltar gsung gi dbang thob ngag sgrib dag /rig sngags zab mos sna tshogs las la dbang*// 'bras bu longs sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur//

gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang ni/ mdun bskyed 'phags ma'i sku las slar yang ni// rje btsun ma spros slob ma'i sems la thim// dbyer med rang bzhin spros bral 'od gsal ba// ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang du dar cig zhog /maṇ+ḍal lha mtshan spyi bor bzhag /yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ de ltar thugs kyi dbang thob yid sgrib dag /mi rtog ting 'dzin rnal 'byor bsgom par dbang*// 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// de ltar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i smin byed kyi rjes su gnang ba legs par thob nas rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig bsgrags pa ni/ de yang las sna tshogs pa'i rgyud las/ so so'i dam tshig sdom gnas te// lha yi 'khor lo dang ldan pas// srog chags bsad dang ma byin len// rdzun dang phra ma 'dod log g.yem// ring du spang zhing shes rab kyi// rang bzhin bud med smad mi bya// sems can rnams la ma bzhin du// brtse bas rtag tu bkur sti bya// dam tshig srog la gnas pa yi// las rnams kun la mthu yod 'gyur// de ltar srung sdom rnams tshul bzhin 'dzin snyam pa'i sgo nas yid dam bcas la 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ lus longs spyod 'bul ba'i blos 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod la/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi rim pa mdo tsam bstan zin nas/ rjes kyi cho ga ni/ dang po sngar ltar mchod pa byin rlabs/ sngags mchod phul la/ gnyis pa mtshan nges par grags pas bstod pa ni/ oṃ bcom ldan 'das ma chen mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi btsun mo'i mchog /dam tshig sgrol ma zhes bya ba/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang*/ rdo rje dang*/ rin po che dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ las kyi rigs thams cad kyi bdag po/ rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i byed pa po/ brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba las ches shin tu gsang ba/

gsang ba chen mo'i dbang phyug ma bdag nyid kyi rdo rje'i ming 'di rnams nyid kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje las byung ngo*// bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma/ rdo rje ma/ dam tshig sgrol ma/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma chen mo/ ye shes lngas brgyan pa ma/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi dbang bskur ma/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor/ zla ba'i bde ma/ ngo mtshar bde ma/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi 'dod ma/ phung po'i bdag mo/ skye mched kyi bdag mor gyur pa/ 'byung ba rnams rab tu thob pa/ yul dang bral ba'i rang bzhin/ rgyud kun gyi dbang phyug ma/ ye shes rnam pa lngas byang chub pa/ rdul dang bral ba/ dri ma med pa/ gsang sngags chen mo/ shin tu sra ba/ mtshan dang dpe byad rnams kyis spras pa/ dag byed dag byed chen mo/ las thams cad 'grub par byed pa/ 'dod pa thams cad rab tu sbyin ma/ yi ge bcu pa'i sgra sgrog ma/ sgra sgrog dgyes ma/ gdung ma/ myur ba ma/ rnam par gshegs pa yongs su dag pa/ sra zhing bde ba ye shes snying po/ bde ba chen mo'o// na maḥn maḥ.ār+ya tā ra ya/ zhes pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags ma sgrol ma dkar mo yid bzhin 'khor lo'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pas bdag la mchog thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsol ba dang*/ las bzhi/ grub pa chen po brgyad/ 'chi ba med pa rdo rje'i tshe dang*/ rgud pa med pa'i lang tsho rgyas shing*/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs po che 'byung bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ byang chub sgrub pa'i bgegs dang bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ sems can thams cad bde legs dang dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pas dus kun tu shis pa'i yon tan 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don spyi dang bye brag gang yin pa de rtse gcig gsol ba btab/ 'phags ma dgyes pa dang bcas te phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi rgyas rang dang bsrung bya'i spyi bor reg nas mchog stsol bar rtse gcig tu mos/

gsum pa yi ge brgya pas chad lhag kha bskang*/ gshegs gsol byed na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ badz+ra mu sa ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu ba'am/ rten yod na/ bdag dang 'gro la sogs dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha sa rten bzhugs gang 'os bya/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag sogs dang*/ bzhi pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i tām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor 'das thams cad la phog /de dag kyang rang nyid la thim/ rang nyid kyang rim bzhin 'khor lo dang yig 'bru la thim/ de yang tām̐ la 'dus nas thig le dang nā da/ de yang mi dmigs pa stong nyid 'od gsal gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go / zhes ci gnas su bzhag la/ lnga pa zung 'jug gi skur ldang ba ni/ slar yang rang nyid gsal la 'dzin med 'phags ma'i skur lam gyis gsal ba'i gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mtshan pa dang snang grag gi chos thams cad skye ba med pa lha yi ngo bor rnam par dag go// de nas bkra shis ci rigs pa dang bsngo smon brjod cing rgyun spyod la 'jug par bya'o// de ltar 'phags ma yid bzhin 'khor lo'i cho ga 'jug bder bkod pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed dbon sprul karma 'chi med kyi dgongs bzhed ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos spel ba skye rgu thams cad la dge bar gyur cig /swasti dza yan+tu/// / ༈ sgrol ma 'od zer drug sbrag dbang gi zhal rgyun ni/ bshams bkod sogs spyi mthun dang*/ sngon gtor btang ba/ skyabs sems mchod pa byin rlabs sogs dang/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bdag bskyed mngon rtogs kyi bzlas pa'i thun mjug tu/ skad cig gis phyi rol du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gur thabs su gnas shing mi mngon par myur du 'khor ba'i lte ba zlum po yangs pa'i nang du rang nyid 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs par gsal ba'i thugs kar 'khor lo yig 'bru dang bcas pa/

rang nyid kyi steng du oṃ/ 'og tu hā/ rtsibs kyi rtsa ba sbubs stong gi thad kyi nang du mdun nas g.yas bskor du yi ge brgyad bcas kyi yig 'bru rnams dkar po/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer dkar po shel lta bu/ ser po gser lta bu/ dmar po pad+ma rā ga lta bu/ lcags kha tho rengs kyi gnam lta bu/ ljang gu margad lta bu/ mchin kha in+d+ra nī la lta bu rnams rim par spros/ sems can gyi don byas/ rgyal ba rnams mchod/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi byin rlabs 'od zer dkar ser dmar sngo ljang mthing gi rnam par rim par byon/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim pas/ zhi rgyas dbang drag las sna tshogs pa'i dngos grub thob cing brtan par byas/ 'od lhag ma rnams 'khor lo'i gur khang gi phyi rol 'dom gang tsam nas 'od dkar po'i gur khang*/ de'i phyir ser po/ de'i phyir dmar po/ de'i phyir lcags kha/ de'i phyir ljang gu/ de'i phyir 'od mchin kha'i gur khang rnams kyang 'dom re'i bar thag can/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu 'khor ba'i zlum po'i rnam pa can sra ba/ brtan pa/ srub med pa rlung ser bu tsam yang mi thar ba/ bar stong thams cad ut+pal sngon po kha bye ma thag pas gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod la slar yang bzlas pa bya'o// de nas mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed dkyus bzhin byas la/ dbang gi skabs slob ma la sngags kyis bsangs/ shū n+ya ta sa sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las ma bcos pa'i sems snang hūm̐ gi sgra gdangs nam mkha' gang ba dang bcas pa las phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba rtsibs bcu pa gur thabs su gnas shing mi mngon par myur du 'khor ba lte ba zlum po yangs pa'i nang du/ bh+rūm̐ las zla ba chu shel gyi gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su pam̐ las sogs kyis slob ma lhar bskyed nas/ gnas gsum 'bru gsum bkod/ thugs ka'i dbus su pad dkar dang zla ba la tām̐ dkar pos mtshan pa/

phyi rol srung ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs steng du oṃ/ rtsibs 'og tu hā/ rtsibs kyi rtsa ba sbubs stong gi thad kyi nang du mdun nas g.yas bskor du/ tā/ re/ tuta/ tā/ re/ tu/ re/ swā rnams kyi yig 'bru rnams rab tu dkar ba/ thugs ka'i sa bon tām̐ yig las 'od zer dkar po shel lta bu sogs gong bzhin brjod pa dang*/ thugs ka'i 'khor lo la thim pas sogs nas/ ut+pal sngon po kha bye ma thag pas gang bar gsal thob mdzod/ ces brjod/ de nas bdag mdun lhar bskyed thugs ka'i 'od zer spro bsdus byin dbab pa sogs ni smin dbang spyi ltar gnang bas khyab/ sarba maṅga laṃ/ zhes lhun grub steng gi rgyal khabs su sa dbang mchog gi dgongs pa skang ched du spel ba dge/ ༈ // rgyal mchog tshe dpag med pa'i yum// 'chi med nges par ster ba mo// rig pa 'dzin ma bcom ldan 'das// yid bzhin 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /dge ba 'di yis sems can kun// sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon zhi// tshe dpal bsod nams ye shes rgyas// sgrol ma'i go 'phang myur thob shog sarba maṅga laṃ/// / sgrol dkar zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dus min 'chi 'joms zhes pa bzhugs so// rgyal ba'i yum 'phags ma sgrol ma yid bzhin 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 'dir 'phags ma sgrol dkar gyi sgo nas zhi ba'i sreg blugs bsnyen pa sogs kyi kha skong dang/ dus min 'chi ba sogs bar chad mi mthun pa nad gdon bzlog cing zhi ba'i phyir spro na/ de yang rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni// sbyin sreg khri phrag byed par bshad// ces pa ltar/ bzlas pa'i bcu cha'i grangs kyi sbyin sreg dgos shing/ thog mar 'di nyid kyi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ dus chen bzhi'am/ nyi zla sgra gcan du zhugs pa'i dus sam/

sbyor ba bzang po'i nyi mar/ bco lnga lta bu'i srod dang tho rangs la/ sreg blugs 'bul bar bya ste/ paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa'i kun btus las/ zho dang sbrang rtsi mar gyis sbags// dūrba'i myu gu shar dang ni// byang du rtse bstan sbyin sreg bya// sngon gyi las mthu las 'byung ba'i// 'chi ba'ang nges par zlog par byed// ces la sogs pa gsungs shing phan yon mchog dang ldan pa ste/ de yang thog mar srog chags sogs med pa'i sar rkyang nul legs par byas la/ dang po thig gdab pa ni/ tshangs zur bzhi po legs btab ste// dbus nas lag sor bcu gnyis dang// slar yang bzhi pa gnyis rim bskor// rgya khyon mchu dang kha khyer yin// de dbus sor bzhi pad lte bskor// tshangs zur dbus gshag gcus thig gdab// pad 'dab brgyad 'byung kha khyer la// rdo rje'i phreng bas kun nas bskor// grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje dang*// dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad ster// rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga bri// kun kyang dkar po'i tshon gyis bsgyur// ces so// gnyis pa bud shing ba lu'am shug pa sogs dri zhim po dang*/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pa mchu yi nang du dam par sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad du zlum par brtsigs/ shar lhor rdza kong zhig kyang bzhag /de nas yo byad bshams pa ni rang gi g.yon phyogs nas g.yas skor gyi stegs mtho dma' 'am phyi nang byas pa'i khar 'das ma 'das kyi mar gyi gtor zlum gnyis dang chu bzhi nyer spyod tshar gnyis re bshams/ g.yas phyogs su yam shing rgyu ba lu sogs 'o ma can gyi shing rtse rnal 'byor ba'i mthe'u chung gi tshad dam sor bcu gnyis pa rtse mor dkar gsum gyis sbags pa ji tsam 'os pa dang*/ mar khu/ til nag /yungs kar/ dkar mngar drug 'dres kyi zas mchog /zho/ 'bras/ so ba/ nas/ sran ma/ gro/ dūrba/ ku sha rtse dkar gsum gyis sbags pa/ shing tog sna tshogs rnams bshams/

rang kha shar du bltas la skyil krung ngam tsog pur 'dug /mdun du me yol/ ku sha chun po bcu/ rdor dril dgang blugs kha sbyar/ dung chos bsangs gtor gyi ku sha sogs nyer mkho rnams 'du bar byas la/ dang po sgrub thabs dngos grub mchog stsol nas 'byung ba ltar sngon 'gro skyabs sems bdag bskyed bsnyen pa dang*/ rjes gzhig gi rnal 'byor dang zung 'jug gi skur ldang la/ gnyis pa gzhung ltar sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ 'di nas bzung ngag smra bcad/ yid ting nge 'dzin/ lag rdor dril dang mi 'bral bar rdzas rnams la yungs kar gyis brab nas/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom la/ rung khang las byung ba'i me blangs la

badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ dpal 'bar spar te bsang chu dor/ badz+ra kro dha sogs brjod/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la dz+wa la hūm̐/ zhes thab kyi shar lhor bzhag /oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis rlung g.yab cing spar ro// de nas yi ge bcu pa'i mthar dgang blugs kyis mar khu lan gsum mam bdun 'bul bas me gsos la/ pad skor dang bcas/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge// tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa// sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*// bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni// zhi dang bkra shis mdzad du gsol// oṃ badz+ra sa twa āḥ zhes rtse mo g.yas bstan gyis thab kyi phyogs brgyad du bkod la/ gzhung nas 'byung bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs/ añca mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa naṃ 'dzud dgos dang/ sreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ las rin po che'i snod du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las ngo bo bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin rnam pa 'dod yon sna tshogs gyur/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ dgang blugs kha sbyar bzung la mar khu la reg la/ oṃ ā swā hā/ yam shing la/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ 'bru thams cad la/ oṃ dz+riṃ swā hā/ sbyang ba'o// sreg rdzas thams cad la reg ste/ oṃ swā hā/ bkru ba'o// rdzas thams cad la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ byin rlabs dang*/ de nas gsum pa thab bskyed pa ni/ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ thab khung mi dmigs stong nyid gyur// stong las pad nyi'i steng du hūm̐// zhi ba'i thab khung zlum po dkar// gru gang rgya khyon rgya phyed dpangs// sor bzhi mchu dang kha khyer steng*// rdor phreng grwa bzhir zla phyed dang*// rdo rje'i rgyan dbus pad 'dab brgyad// lte bar rdo rjes mtshan par gyur// thab dbus me dkyil pad nyi'i steng*// ram̐ las me lha dkar po ni// me thab ril 'dzin drang srong tshul// ral pa'i thor tshugs ag tshom can// gsus 'phyang tshangs skud dkar pos brgyan// ra skyes la gnas drang srong bskor// gnas gsum oṃ āḥhūm̐ yig las// 'od 'phros me lha shar lho nas// 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs gyur//

lag g.yon pas g.yas pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste ku sha dang bcas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa bar g.yob cing*/ oṃ/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// lha yi rgyal po bram ze mchog /sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'dir ni yang dag bsnyen par mdzod// gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// 'dod pa thams cad rab sgrub pa// thugs rjes sems can don gyi phyir// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ṭā ki hūm̐ dzaḥ thab kyi shar lhor me tog gcig 'phang la/ pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yaṃ/ añca mā naṃ/ prok+ṣa naṃ/ zhes chu bzhi dbul/ lag g.yas pas rtse gsum gyi rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhu ta dz+wa la ya sarba bhasmin ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ dri sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ sa ma ya ham̐ḥ zhes dam la bzhag dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ ye shes dang*// dam tshig dbyer med slar yang ni// thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis dbang lha rnams// spyan drangs dbang bskur dri ma dag /rnam snang mdzad kyis rgyas gdab gyur// oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra puṣ+pe pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ shab+da bar gyis gdan mchod phul/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha ṭāk+kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs sreg /drang srong me lha'i tshogs la bstod// ces bstod/ dgang blugs kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// me lha'i ljags la ram̐ yig mtshan// sreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// na maḥs+sa man+ta bud+dhā na o ag+na ye ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya a di bya/ byang chub mchog gi rgyas mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun byon zan 'bul/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi dam pa'i chos kyi bsam sbyor la bar du gcod pa rnams dang sdig sgrib nyes ltung nad gdon sarba shan+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/

bzhi pa sreg rdzas dbul te yam shing rtse mo steng du bstan la g.yas pas mtheb srin gyis dbul nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ sngags bzla grogs du yod kyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i yam shing sogs sreg rdzas rnams sngags res dbul nas grangs de ltar 'dzin tshar gsum mam bdun re'i mthar/ oṃ bho dhi bṛk+ṣa ya= rjes su/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu gong ltar sngags thog ma 'dra bar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blugs kyis phul/ grangs sogs gong ltar dang spel tshig thog mtha' 'dra bar/ 'byor pa= til nag / oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya swā hā/ gung mtheb kyis dbul/ 'bru gzhan dang ku sha dūrba sogs kyang 'di ltar phul/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung bar du= yungs kar/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dhi ye swā hā/ gnod byed gdon bgegs bar du= zas mchog / oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la= zho ste/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ shes rab= blugs gzar gyis phul/ 'bras so ba ste/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swā hā/ khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la= so ba ste/ oṃ badz+ra bī dza ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru la bar du= nas te/ oṃ ma hā be gā ya swā hā/ lus kyi shugs rnams rgyas pa la bar du= sran ma ste/ oṃ ma hā bā la ya swā hā/ lus kyi stobs rnams rgyas pa la= gro ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ lus kyi nad med pa la bar du= dūrba ste/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe srog ring du gnas pa la bar du= ku sha ste/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba la bar du= shing thog ste/ oṃ badz+ra ṣī bā ya swā hā/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi chos dang rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas sdig pa zhi bar 'dod na til/

tshe ring bar dūrba/ bgegs zhi bar yungs kar sogs phul ba rigs pas dpyad do// de nas mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ nas/ shab+da 'i bar dang/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul/ badz+ra kro dha sa thab dang yo byad bsangs/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur// de nas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i cho ga ni/ dang po thab kyi dbus su bskyed pa ni gzhung ltar/ de yi dbus su pam̐ las ni// sogs dang*/ 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog dkar// zhes pa'i khyad par de nas spyan 'dren dbang bskur rgyas gdab par byas la/ byon zan 'bul ba ni/ dgang blug kha la hūm̐ yig gsal// bcom ldan 'das ma'i ljags la yang// tām̐ yig dag gis mtshan pa yis// bsreg rdzas bdud rtsi bzhes par gyur// oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re sa pa ri wā ra ha bya ka bya bā ha na ya a di bya/ lan gsum mam bdun gyis mar khu 'bul zhing*/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi dam pa'i chos kyi bsam sbyor la bar du gcod pa rnams dang*/ dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drug sarba shīn+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ de nas gnyis pa mchod pa byin rlabs gzhung bzhin dang*/ dri med mchod yon dag byed zhabs bsil dang*// rab tu sim byed bsangs gtor 'thor 'thung bzang*// yid 'ong me tog ces sogs/ añca mā naṃ= prok+ṣa naṃ sbyar/ 'jig rten 'di na sogs kyis mchod/ zhing khams thams cad yongs su dag pa la// rin chen me tog mang po gcal du bkram// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yum// yum gyur sgrol ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma sgrol ma sgrol mdzad yum// yid bzhin 'khor lo tshe 'phel ma// lha mo khyod la gsol ba ni// bdag gi tshe yi bar chad dang// nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad las// nus ldan khyod kyis bskyab tu gsol// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub kun// ma lus bdag la gnang bar mdzod// 'phags ma khyod la dad byed pa// de la rtag tu bu bzhin dgongs// bdag kyang khyod la gsol 'debs kyis// thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung du gsol//

zhes pas bstod/ de nas gsum pa sreg rdzas 'bul ba ni/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā/ yam shing re sngags dang bstun nas zla grogs du yod kyi grangs dang bstun nas 'bul zhing grangs 'dzin pa sogs gong 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar dang*/ bzlas pa'i kha skong gi grangs gsog pa'ang 'di bzhin dgos/ bṛk+ṣā ya/ bdag cag dpon slob rnams kyi gzi brjid phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sarba shīn+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ mar khu/ yig bcu'i mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ dgang blugs kyis phul/ spel tshig thog mtha' 'dra bar/ 'byor pa/ til nag /oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye swā hā/ 'bru'i rigs thams cad mtheb srin gyis phul/ sdig sgrib nyes ltung bar du= yungs kar/ oṃ sarba ar+tha sid+dha ye swā hā/ gnod byed gdon bgegs bar du= zas mchog /oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun sum tshogs pa la= zho ste/ oṃ sarba sam+ba de swā hā/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa la= 'bras so ba/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ya swā hā/ khyim gyi dpal 'byor rgyas pa la bar du= so ba ste/ oṃ badz+ra bī dzā ya swā hā/ nor dang 'bru la bar du= nas te/ oṃ ma hā bā+e gā ya swā hā/ lus kyi shugs rgyas pa la bar du= sran ma ste/ oṃ ma hā ba la ya swā hā/ lus kyi stobs rgyas pa la bar du= gro ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma re swā hā/ lus kyi nad med pa la bar du= dūrba ste/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ tshe srog ring du gnas pa la bar du= ku sha ste/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swā hā/ mi mthun phyogs rnams srung ba bar du= shing thog sna tshogs te/ oṃ badz+ra ṣi bā ya swā hā/ chos dang rigs rgyud phun sum tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa sarba shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes 'bul zhing*/ sreg rdzas snod gcig tu bsdus la/ snying po'i mthar/ sarba pā paṃ shīn+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ btags la 'bul zhing grangs gsog pa'ang bzhed/

na bza'/ me tog /spos rnams snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum gyis dbul/ spro na lha khrus spyi 'gro ltar bya/ bsdu na mi dgos/ de nas gzhung ltar/ dri med mchod yon sogs chu bzhi nyer spyod bcas dang*/ 'jig rten 'di na sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul nas/ lha dang lha min gyis bstod/ bzhi pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni gzhung las 'byung ba ltar/ badz+ra kro dha sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sogs nas dkyus ltar/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// bar/ sngar gyi 'das gtor mar gyis bcos pa de dgang gzar khar bzhag la 'od du zhur bcug /phrin las bcol/ lnga pa 'dod don gsol ba ni/ yig bcu'i mthar/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum phul te/ thal mo sbyar la/ lhag pa'i lha mchog rje btsun ma// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos la bar gcod pa'i// nyer 'tshe nad gdon sdug bsngal dang*// dus min 'chi dang 'jigs chen brgyad// mdor na mi mthun phyogs thams cad// zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// rang lha yi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po srid pa gsum khyab par 'phros/ bsgrub byar thim pas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag /nad gdon sogs zhi zhing byang bar dmigs/ de nas drug pa gtang rag gi mchod bstod ni/ oṃ ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pād+yaṃ/ añca ma naṃ/ prok+ṣa naṃ/ puṣ+pe nas/ shab+da 'i bar sngags thog mtha' 'dra bar brjod/ 'khor ba las sgrol tā re ma sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya bzlas shing chad lhag bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod gsol dang*/ bdun pa gshegs gsol skabs/ /ār+ya tā re sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ prok+ṣa naṃ/ zhes bsangs gtor dang 'thor 'thung phul/ mchod yon sbreng bzhin pas/ yig brgya brjod/ oṃ/ khyod kyis sems can

sogs kyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis snying gar bsdu/ de nas rjes chog ni/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ mar khu dgang blugs gsum mam bdun phul/ slar yang me lha 'khor bcas rnams// 'bar ba'i rnam pas bzhengs par gsal// sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams grangs mi 'dzin pa sngar gyi 'jig rten pa'i skabs ltar phul/ dang po/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ bodhi bṛk+ṣa ya swā hā sa spel tshig dang bcas shing thog phul ba'i bar so sor brjod la/ na bza'/ me tog spos rnams kyang snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul/ khrus gsol ma grub kyang 'gal ba med/ mchod bstod ni/ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da bar dang*/ tshangs dbang 'jig rten sogs kyis bstod/ gnyis pa 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma/ a kā ro sa byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis 'bul la/ gtor ma dgang gzar khar bzhag la zhur bcug nas/ me ste bsreg bya za ba'i lha// drang srong rgyal po gdon gyi bdag /shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// zhes sogs brjod de phrin las bcol/ gsum pa 'dod don gsol ba ni/ thal mo sbyar/ drang srong chen po me yi lha// 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas kyi// dam pa'i chos la bar gcod pa'i// nyer 'tshe nad gdon sdug bsngal dang*// dus min 'chi ba la sogs pa// mdor na mi mthun phyogs thams cad// zhi zhing med par mdzad du gsol// de nas yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang*/ bzhi pa gshegs gsol ni/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra añca ma naṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin du/ pro k+ṣa naṃ sbyar la yig brgya brjod bzhin pas mchod yon sbreng ste/ gshegs gsol gyi dril stabs bcas/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyi bsgrub kyis gshegs// ji ltar gnas su slar gshegs te// bdag gi 'dod pa thams cad sgrub// oṃ ag+na ye sa pā ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ

ye shes me lha shar lhor gshegs// dam tshig pa rnams snying gar thim// de nas bsngo ba dang smon lam gyi rgyas gdab dang bkra shis sogs brjod par bya'o// thab kyi me mi bsgul bar bzhag la/ yang na 'o ma dang dri bzang gi chus me mtha' nas zhi bar byas la/ rdo rje bsdu ba'i rgyas bsdus te thal ba ri mthon po'i rtse'am/ rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chur gdan drangs na bsod nams che'o// de ltar 'phags ma sgrol ma'i sgo nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gi rim pa khyer bder bsdus pa 'di bzhin sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i shing rta pa dbon sprul karma 'chi med kyi bzhed pa ltar/ si tu pad+ma nyin byed dbang pos zin thor bkod pa 'gro rnams 'chi med ye shes chen po'i go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig /su dza yan+tu/// /
